attributes.name: Lucky Rifle +2
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Dexterity or Ranged skill + 1d12+2. If proficient with weapons and you would fail this check, you may bury this card to add 1d12 to the result.

If a character at another location would fail a combat check, bury this card to add 1d4+1 to the result.
